$comment: cardConflicts.autoResolveRaisedBy (boolean, standard true): card-only PRs with conflicts entirely inside an Also raised by list use a stable main-first union; relaxation #10 carries a standing acceptance only for proven list-only changes, otherwise fresh review. Cascade: standard → platform cardConflicts → declared repo settings → WE_CARD_CONFLICTS_AUTO_RESOLVE_RAISED_BY (true/false/1/0). cardConflicts.gitRecheckFiles (boolean, standard true): recheck stale GitHub file lists with a pinned git diff before routing eligible main-base lane PRs to the existing strict card resolver. Same cascade; env WE_CARD_CONFLICTS_GIT_RECHECK_FILES (true/false/1/0). Every other conflict keeps its existing owner and guards. cardConflicts.carryAcceptanceOnUnion (boolean, standard true): relaxation #10 preserves an existing acceptance only after a git proof of resolver list union alone; otherwise fresh review. Same cascade; env WE_CARD_CONFLICTS_CARRY_ACCEPTANCE_ON_UNION (true/false/1/0). Pending acceptance restoration is not authorized.
